_comment: Parallel-file consistency groups (issues #131, #210; Rule 14). Each group names a kind implemented in tools/check-doc-consistency.mjs and the files it diffs. To add a group: pick a kind (delegate | rfc-table | script-inventory | hook-gates | same-line), add an entry with a unique id and a one-line why, run `node tools/check-doc-consistency.mjs`, and add a seeded-drift case to tests/test-check-doc-consistency.mjs. A new kind needs a checker function plus a test; see the tool header.

groups.why: RFC frontmatter status/title <-> docs/rfcs/_index.json <-> docs/rfcs/README.md Active RFCs table is already validated by em-rfc-validate; reused here, not re-implemented.
The top-level README RFC table missed RFC-004/005/006 (2026-05-09) and later RFC-012..015 with RFC-007 still shown as Draft (#210).
README Scripts Reference missed 12 shipped scripts (2026-05-09) and 29 by 2026-09-26 (#210). Every scripts/*.mjs is documented in that section or named below as internal.

internal.bp1-rfc-scan.mjs: RFC scan helper spawned by bp1-orchestrator.mjs
internal.checkpoint-marker.mjs: checkpoint quartet marker helper called by checkpoint-gate.sh
internal.classifier-config-loader.mjs: config resolver imported by the classifier dispatch scripts
internal.classifier-marker.mjs: per-session classification marker helper called by checkpoint-gate.sh
internal.classifier-override-lookup.mjs: Tier 0 override read helper called by hooks/lib/command-classifier.sh
internal.classifier-override-persist.mjs: verdict auto-persist helper called by hooks/lib/agent-classifier.sh
internal.em-lock.mjs: atomic file lock used by em-routines and em-backup-sync paths
internal.enforce-contract.mjs: enforcement thin-waist called by the gate hooks (RFC-008 P3b)
internal.llm-classify.mjs: Tier 3 intent classifier called by the classifier dispatch scripts
internal.plan-marker.mjs: plan-approval marker helper called by the gate hooks (USER_MANUAL Scenario 12 shows its one operator use)
internal.preflight-marker-write.mjs: pre-flight marker writer called by preflight-gate.sh and command-classifier.sh

groups.why: USER_MANUAL Scenario 12 listed 2 of 3 active gates (2026-05-09). The installed gate set is HOOK_SPECS in scripts/lib/install-manifest.mjs (the list install.mjs registers); Scenario 12 must name exactly those gates and state their count.
